name: zgeometry_weiler_classify_input_contour_pair_bounds
description: zGeometry_Weiler::ClassifyInputContourPairBounds preclassifies two input contour bounding boxes before full Weiler clipping.
known_limits: Binary Ninja has a documented cursor-rendering limitation while walking zVec3 bounds, but the assembly and source contract are behaviorally reviewed. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x464c90 validates disjoint-bounds return 1, bounds-containment calls into 0x464ea0 with result codes 2 or 3, and partial-overlap return 0.
The native clip leaf smoke verifies disjoint, B contains A, B inside A, identical, and partial-overlap cases.
